instruction_bn: নিয়ম মেনে আবেদনপত্র/formal letter লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 10 marks)।

items.prompt: Write an application to the Headmaster of your school for a character certificate.
items.model:
Date: 10 May 2026

To
The Headmaster
[Name] High School, Dhaka

Subject: Prayer for a character certificate.

Sir,
With due respect, I beg to state that I have passed the S.S.C. examination from your school this year. Now I want to get admitted into a college for higher study. For this purpose I need a character certificate from you.

During my school life I always obeyed the rules of the school and never did anything against its discipline.

I, therefore, pray and hope that you would be kind enough to grant me a character certificate mentioning my conduct, and oblige thereby.

I remain,
Sir,
Your most obedient pupil,
Sabbir Ahmed
S.S.C. Batch 2026, Roll: 03
rubric: শেষে 'Your most obedient pupil' + নাম দিয়েছি

If a bridge is built over the canal, the sufferings of the villagers will be removed.

We, therefore, pray and hope that you would kindly take necessary steps to construct a bridge over the canal and oblige thereby.

Yours faithfully,
The inhabitants of Shantipur village
